name: mahjong-for-friends
description: Casual 4-player mahjong for friends: four sets + one pair wins, no minimum score.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mahjong/client && npm run build -w @mahjong/server
